RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyIntro: This tunnel goes a long way, kid!
RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyPostBattle:
Watch for ONIX. They appear only occasionally.
High-level ones can put the squeeze on you!
RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverIntro: Hmm. Maybe I'm lost in here…
RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverDefeat: Ease up! What am I doing? Which way is out?
RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverPostBattle: That sleeping POKéMON on ROUTE 12 forced me to take this detour.
RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasIntro: Outsiders like you need to show me some respect!
RockTunnel_1F_Text_AshtonPostBattle: Oh well, I'll get a ZUBAT as I go!
RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahIntro:
Eek!
Don't try anything funny in the dark!
RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahPostBattle: I saw a MACHOP in this tunnel.
RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaIntro: I came this far looking for wild POKéMON.
RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaPostBattle: You looked cute and harmless. Was I ever wrong!
